label: renderer-shader-tool
command:
set -e
source_dir="$PWD/artifacts/terrain-decoration-pr/linux/glslang-source"
tool_dir="$PWD/artifacts/terrain-decoration-pr/linux/glslang-tools"
git init "$source_dir"
git -C "$source_dir" fetch --depth 1 https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang.git 1062752a891c95b2bfeed9e356562d88f9df84ac
git -C "$source_dir" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
cmake -S "$source_dir" -B "$tool_dir" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DENABLE_OPT=OFF -DENABLE_GLSLANG_BINARIES=ON -DENABLE_HLSL=OFF
cmake --build "$tool_dir" -j16
"$tool_dir/StandAlone/glslang" --version
